name: Koth
description: Koth of the Hammer is a Mirran planeswalker and geomancer who leads the Mirran resistance against the Phyrexians that conquered his plane.

summary.text: Koth of the Hammer is a Mirran planeswalker and geomancer who leads the Mirran resistance against the Phyrexians that conquered his plane.

bio.text: Koth, Elspeth and Venser could not turn the tide on New Phyrexia, and Venser sacrificed his life to restore Karn to sanity.
Years later Elspeth was reunited with Koth, whom she thought dead, and he guided the planeswalkers' team through the Dross Pits, revealing he had once escaped Sheoldred's Coliseum.
He and Melira stayed behind to free Karn, and later he led the Mirran survivors and launched Chandra and Wrenn across a chasm toward the tree.
Captured and brought before Norn, he was healed by Elspeth, then called magma and rallied the Mirrans in the retreat, but Melira was struck down on the bridge as he screamed.
He rallied the Mirrans when Zhalfir came to New Phyrexia, stayed at Melira's side as she chose to give her life to heal Nissa and Ajani, and mourned her.
In the new village on Zhalfir he helped Nissa up and returned her weapon, as friends said his spark had faded.

status.text: As of the latest story he is alive in the new village on Zhalfir with the Mirrans, his spark reported to have faded.

timeline.summary: Elspeth calls the plan a death sentence and storms out.
timeline.quote: That's a death sentence,

timeline.summary: Elspeth is reunited with Koth, whom she thought dead.
timeline.quote: Koth, I thought you were dead!

timeline.summary: Melira demands honesty about what the sylex will do to Mirrodin, arguing her people have already survived the end of their plane.
timeline.quote: Your plane doesn't matter so much more than ours that I'm going to help you sacrifice what little we have left.

timeline.summary: Koth explains the route down through the Hunter Maze and Surgical Bay to land in the Dross Pits above the Fair Basilica.
timeline.quote: We'll bypass both to land in the Dross Pits, directly above the Fair Basilica.

timeline.summary: Koth describes the Mirrans' dire survival and resolve; Elspeth apologizes for leaving.
timeline.quote: As long as one of us is breathing, we'll keep fighting back.

timeline.summary: Koth introduces hexgold, a Mirran metal that protects somewhat against phyresis, and offers it for the team's gear.
timeline.quote: Our gear has been treated with a substance we call hexgold.

timeline.summary: Koth announces he will join the descent with a demolition team as a backup if the sylex fails.
timeline.quote: I have a demolition team standing by to do what needs to be done if your sylex fails.

timeline.summary: Jace and Kaya leave by hand-pumped cart into the tunnel to the Dross Pits, and the rest follow.
timeline.quote: made her own descent into the shadows of New Phyrexia

timeline.summary: The team lands in the Dross Pits, a rotting landscape of necrogen pools.
timeline.quote: Pools of glowing green liquid she recognized as necrogen dominated the landscape

timeline.summary: Koth explains the thanes of the Dross Pits, four of whom support Urabrask's rebellion, so the team can use the chaos for cover.
timeline.quote: Seven thanes rule the Dross Pits, but they've never been united.

timeline.summary: Jace breaks free of Tyvar and strides off alone; the group abandons its safe route and follows him because he carries the sylex.
timeline.quote: He has the sylex. If we lose that, we lose everything.

timeline.summary: Koth identifies Sheoldred's Coliseum and reveals that he once escaped it.
timeline.quote: No one exits the coliseum alive and unchanged. I escaped. Mostly.

timeline.summary: Koth, Nahiri, Elspeth, Kaito and Tyvar fight the Phyrexians in the coliseum while Jace crosses unseen to Vraska.
timeline.quote: The remaining Phyrexians never stood a chance against her

timeline.summary: Outside the coliseum, the group is cornered by massed Phyrexian ranks.
timeline.quote: They stepped straight into the middle of a war.

timeline.summary: Elspeth and the others regroup in the rubble, finding a hole in the sky and that Nahiri has vanished.
timeline.quote: Nahiri was nowhere to be seen.

timeline.summary: Kaya relents and hands Jace the sylex, and the group sets off toward Norn's altar.
timeline.quote: until finally, with a disgusted expression, she shoved it into his arms

timeline.summary: The survivors hurry across the Fair Basilica's bridges, mourning Nahiri's sacrifice.
timeline.quote: We have to keep moving to honor the ending she chose.

timeline.summary: Koth explains Elesh Norn ossifies her favorites and adds them to her Fair Basilica as the group passes a colossus.
timeline.quote: Turned to bone and added to her Fair Basilica.

timeline.summary: Tyvar and Melira discuss how the corrupted World Tree should have split the plane, and Melira says Karn is imprisoned beneath it.
timeline.quote: Norn's tree is planted below in the Seedcore, where she imprisoned Karn.

timeline.summary: The team descends into the Mycosynth Gardens, where Melira warns them not to touch the mycosynth.
timeline.quote: This is how Phyrexia took us in the first place.

timeline.summary: Melira leads them to the infectious gateway into the Seedcore.
timeline.quote: The gateway into the Seedcore. It infects anything it touches.

timeline.summary: Tyvar spreads Glimmervoid metal over the entire group and Kaito lifts the oil so they can pass through the gateway safely.
timeline.quote: until his body was a Glimmervoid metal sculpture.

timeline.summary: They emerge in the Seedcore and see Realmbreaker, the corrupted World Tree, for the first time.
timeline.quote: Kaya turned and beheld the Phyrexian World Tree. Realmbreaker.

timeline.summary: A flash from the upper branches signals that the World Tree has connected to the Multiverse and the invasion has begun.
timeline.quote: The World Tree has connected to the Multiverse.

timeline.summary: The group finds Karn vivisected and bound at the center of the root chamber.
timeline.quote: The great silver golem had been broken open, vivisected, and spread across the platform.

timeline.summary: Koth and Melira stay behind to free Karn while Elspeth goes on, refusing to run any more.
timeline.quote: No more running.

timeline.summary: They find Mirran survivors under Koth and Melira, and Chandra pitches that Wrenn will bond with the tree to guide it.
timeline.quote: We'll head for the tree. Once we're there, I'll attach myself to him, and try to guide him,

timeline.summary: Koth says Karn was taken near the tree and agrees to try to take control of the tree and rescue him.
timeline.quote: We may as well try to gain control of the tree and rescue him at the same time.

timeline.summary: Urabrask explains the guarded pathways and why he helps, saying he serves no one.
timeline.quote: Urabrask serves no one.

timeline.summary: They plan to have Koth launch Chandra and Wrenn across a chasm while the Mirrans distract Norn.
timeline.quote: The rest of the Mirrans will provide a tantalizing distraction for the so-called Mother of Machines.

timeline.summary: Chandra realizes the platform belongs to Nissa and agrees to the plan.
timeline.quote: Let's do it,

timeline.summary: Koth launches Chandra and Wrenn through the air, and bladed bats attack.
timeline.quote: Koth drives his fist into the earth.

timeline.summary: Koth, Wrenn and Chandra are brought as prisoners, and Elspeth recognizes Nissa as a Phyrexian centurion delivering them.
timeline.quote: "Behold the traitors," speaks one of the centurions

timeline.summary: Norn orders Jin-Gitaxias to harvest what is left of Koth's rebellion and he steps toward the prisoners.
timeline.quote: Jin-Gitaxias. Come harvest what is left of Koth's little rebellion.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Karn recalls leaving word not to follow him when he first tried to solve Mirrodin's Phyrexian problem, and being saved by Venser's sacrifice.
timeline.quote: If it wasn't for Venser sacrificing his spark, Karn would be dead.

timeline.summary: Elspeth heals Chandra and Koth while Norn rages, throwing pieces of her throne that shatter against Elspeth's wing.
timeline.quote: Healing light flows from her into the pyromancer.

timeline.summary: Phyrexian ranks falter and Koth, healed, calls magma and rallies the Mirrans.
timeline.quote: "Mirrodin!" says Koth. "With me!"

timeline.summary: Melira frees Karn's platform and Koth uses stone to bring Karn along with the fleeing group.
timeline.quote: Karn's slab flies out to meet them.

timeline.summary: Melira is struck down by Phyrexian spears on the bridge as Koth screams.
timeline.quote: That person crumpling to the ground—is that Melira?

timeline.summary: Carried by Chandra toward the Invasion Tree, Wrenn fears she cannot do what everyone relies on her to do, as the tree does not answer her.
timeline.quote: That is what truly frightens Wrenn: the possibility that she may not be able to do what everyone is relying upon her to do.

timeline.summary: Koth shields the group from a rain of needles as Chandra, struggling, carries Wrenn.
timeline.quote: Koth levitates the metal beneath their feet to a shield over their heads.

timeline.summary: Koth creates a metal barricade to stop Nissa, who strides over the bridge on cable-like roots.
timeline.quote: Metal groans up and grows, forming a barrier to stop Nissa's approach.

timeline.summary: Teferi visits the healer's ward and finds Karn, Koth, Chandra and Kaya arguing around comatose Nissa and Ajani and the dying Melira.
timeline.quote: The air in the room is taut as a bowstring when Teferi enters.

timeline.summary: In a flashback, Saheeli explains that Phyrexia's oil likely carried Norn's signal and without her the compleated are inert and asleep.
timeline.quote: I think all of it was tied back to Norn.

timeline.summary: Melira proposes a plan to heal Nissa and Ajani that will cost her life and Karn's spark.
timeline.quote: "I think I have an idea for fixing the two of them."

timeline.summary: Koth seeks advice from Elspeth about Melira's plan and whether Ajani and Nissa deserve mercy.
timeline.quote: "It's going to kill her, doing that," Koth says.

timeline.summary: Elspeth tells Koth that Melira chooses her end freely and urges him to make Zhalfir home, then flies him to the ward.
timeline.quote: "You will try to make this place home. It will welcome you, if you let it."

timeline.summary: Teferi stops time in a bubble so Melira and Karn can cleanse Nissa and Ajani.
timeline.quote: But here they have only the space between two beats of a drum to save their friends.

timeline.summary: Ajani wakes briefly and falls asleep; Melira dies, and Koth, Teferi and Karn comfort one another.
timeline.quote: "She's gone."

timeline.summary: The Zhalfirins charge the Phyrexians and Teferi tells Koth the planes are swapping, with Zhalfir coming home.
timeline.quote: "The two planes are swapping places

timeline.summary: Koth rallies the Mirrans and the Zhalfirins drive a wedge into the Phyrexian army.
timeline.quote: After only minutes on the field, the Zhalfirins drive a wedge into the Phyrexian army's forces

timeline.summary: Teferi calls the retreat and the Zhalfirins fend off Phyrexians as the Mirrans pass through the portal.
timeline.quote: "Clear a path for the Mirrans!"

timeline.summary: Nissa attacks Chandra and Koth, and Elspeth knocks her out of her armor and sky; Chandra catches her.
timeline.quote: The elf drops like a stone out of her armor, and out of the sky.

timeline.summary: Nissa digs a grave at night in Zhalfir, wondering whether she lost her spark; her friends say Teferi's and Koth's sparks have faded too.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: is this what happens when a Planeswalker loses her spark?

timeline.summary: Nissa tries to feel Zhalfir but the plane does not answer, and she feels cut off from the Multiverse as the others settle in the new village.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: But Zhalfir still never spoke to her.

timeline.summary: Nissa fails to summon an elemental and is thrown by the beast; Teferi freezes it and Karn holds it before it escapes.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: She sees Teferi, staff outstretched, his radiant, blue spell holding the beast in place.

timeline.summary: The group studies the portal; Nissa hears faint Zendikar in it and the others advise caution and a hunt for the creature first.
timeline.storyline: March of the Machine: The Aftermath
timeline.quote: it sounds like Zendikar.

timeline.summary: Koth refuses to abandon the remnants of his people and fights on against overwhelming odds to protect survivors and punish the monsters who destroyed his home.
timeline.quote: he refuses to abandon the remnants of his people.

timeline.summary: Koth, Elspeth and Venser cannot turn the tide, and Venser sacrifices his life to restore Karn to sanity.
timeline.quote: Venser sacrificed his life to restore Karn to sanity.

relations.note: Urabrask is communicating with the Mirrans.
relations.quote: He's planning his own revolution and is communicating with the Mirrans.

relations.note: Koth had her watch for the planeswalkers
relations.quote: why Koth had me watching for you

relations.note: Elspeth heals Koth and protects the Mirran escape
relations.quote: she keeps her attention on Chandra, then on Koth.
"But I will always be your friend, Koth.

pages_say.description: A planeswalker Elspeth thinks of in the context of New Phyrexia.
A Mirran leader who is alive and planning an assault on the Phyrexian core.
An ally of Elspeth who is alive.
A Mirran Resistance leader who told the Mirrans the planeswalkers were coming.
A planeswalker and geomancer who leads Mirran Resistance forces and will join the descent with a demolition team.
A planeswalker and Mirran Resistance leader who guides the team through the Dross Pits and who escaped Sheoldred's Coliseum once.
A planeswalker and Mirran Resistance leader who guides the team and stays behind with his explosives team to free Karn.
A planeswalker and Mirran Resistance leader who devises a plan to fling Chandra and Wrenn to the tree.
A beaten rebel leader of the Mirran resistance who is brought before Norn.
A Mirran planeswalker who calls magma from the bridge and leads the retreat to the Invasion Tree.
A Mirran planeswalker who shields the group with metal and builds a barricade.
A Mirran planeswalker mourning Mirrodin who struggles to call Zhalfir home and loses Melira.
A Mirran planeswalker who overseas the portal and rallies Mirrans.
A Mirran who helps build the new village and warns of protecting their new home.
A Planeswalker Kaya recalls as a lesson in caring for the world that made you.
A planeswalker and freedom fighter waging war against an extra-planar evil that conquered his native plane.
A planeswalker who could not turn the tide against the Phyrexians.
